stories.headline: Sysco to Acquire Jetro Restaurant Depot for $29.1 Billion Including Debt

key_facts.fact: Sysco will acquire family-owned Jetro Restaurant Depot in a deal with a total enterprise value of approximately $29.1 billion, including debt, marking its entry into the cash-and-carry channel.
key_facts.excerpt: Sysco said on Monday it would buy catering supplier Jetro Restaurant Depot in a $29 billion deal including debt, expanding the top U.S. food distributor's reach among price-conscious independent restaurants.

key_facts.fact: Restaurant Depot shareholders will receive $21.6 billion in cash and 91.5 million Sysco shares, giving them a roughly 16% stake in the combined company.
key_facts.excerpt: Restaurant Depot shareholders will receive $21.6 billion in cash and 91.5 million Sysco shares, giving them a roughly 16% stake in the combined company, the companies said.

key_facts.fact: Sysco will fund the deal through $21 billion of new and hybrid debt plus $1 billion of cash and equity on hand, and will pause its share repurchase program.
key_facts.excerpt: Sysco would fund the deal through $21 billion of new and hybrid debt, along with $1 billion of cash and equity on hand.

key_facts.fact: Restaurant Depot operates a wholesale cash-and-carry model with about 166 warehouse locations across 35 U.S. states, complementing Sysco's delivery network.
key_facts.excerpt: Restaurant Depot has about 166 warehouse locations across 35 U.S. states.

key_facts.fact: Sysco shares fell about 5-8% in premarket trading on the news. The deal is expected to add mid- to high-single-digit EPS accretion in the first year after closing, expected by Q3 fiscal 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: Shares of Sysco, which has a market capitalization of $39.2 billion, fell about 8% in premarket trading... Sysco expects the acquisition to boost earnings per share by a mid- to high-single-digit percentage in the first year after closing, which it expects by the third quarter of fiscal 2027.

key_facts.fact: Paul, Weiss is advising Sysco on the acquisition. Restaurant Depot was founded in Brooklyn in 1976 and is the nation's largest cash-and-carry wholesaler.
key_facts.excerpt: Paul, Weiss is advising Sysco, the world's largest food-away-from-home distributor, on its acquisition of Jetro Restaurant Depot, the nation's premier cash & carry food wholesaler.

key_facts.fact: The deal follows failed merger talks last year between US Foods and Performance Food Group, which would have created a combined challenger to Sysco.
key_facts.excerpt: Last year, US Foods ended merger talks with Performance Food, which would have tied together the nation's No. 2 and No. 3 food-service distributors in an effort to challenge industry leader Sysco.

sources.title: Top US food supplier Sysco strikes $29 billion deal for Jetro Restaurant Depot

stories.headline: Eli Lilly and Insilico Medicine Sign $2.75 Billion AI Drug Discovery Deal

key_facts.fact: Insilico Medicine signed a global licensing and research deal with Eli Lilly worth up to $2.75 billion including milestone payments, with a $115 million upfront payment.
key_facts.excerpt: Insilico Medicine said on Sunday it has agreed a global licensing and research deal with U.S. drugmaker Eli Lilly, that could be worth up to $2.75 billion, including milestone payments.

key_facts.fact: Lilly receives an exclusive worldwide license to develop, manufacture and commercialize preclinical oral drug candidates discovered by Insilico's AI, including a GLP-1 drug for diabetes.
key_facts.excerpt: The agreement grants Lilly an exclusive worldwide license for the development, manufacturing, and commercialization of potentially best-in-class, novel oral therapeutics in preclinical development for certain indications.

key_facts.fact: Insilico has developed at least 28 drugs using generative AI, with nearly half already at clinical stage. The company went public in Hong Kong in December 2025 and its shares are up more than 50% year-to-date.
key_facts.excerpt: Insilico has developed at least 28 drugs using generative AI tools, with nearly half already at a clinical stage... The company went public in Hong Kong in December. Its shares are up more than 50% year-to-date.

key_facts.fact: The two companies have collaborated since 2023, when they signed an AI-based software licensing agreement. Insilico will join Lilly's Gateway Labs community for biotech development.
key_facts.excerpt: The two companies have worked together since signing an AI-based software licensing agreement in 2023.

key_facts.fact: The deal includes development, regulatory and commercial milestone payments plus tiered royalties on future sales, reflecting pharma's increasing turn to AI to accelerate R&D.
key_facts.excerpt: Pharmaceutical companies are increasingly turning to AI to accelerate R&D, betting on new modelling tools and automated labs to unlock efficiency gains across their pipeline.

Eli Lilly reaches deal to bring AI-developed drugs to global market

stories.headline: Amazon Acquires Fauna Robotics, Maker of Sprout Humanoid Robot

key_facts.fact: Amazon has acquired Fauna Robotics, a two-year-old New York startup that introduced the Sprout humanoid robot designed for social spaces like homes and schools.
key_facts.excerpt: Amazon has acquired Fauna Robotics, just under two months after the startup introduced a humanoid robot called Sprout designed to be a friendly addition to social spaces like homes and schools.

key_facts.fact: Fauna was founded by former Meta and Google engineers: Josh Merel (Google DeepMind researcher) and Rob Cochran (former head of product at CTRL-Labs, the neural interface company Meta acquired in 2019).
key_facts.excerpt: Fauna is a two-year-old New York start-up founded by former Meta Platforms and Google engineers, specifically Josh Merel, a Google DeepMind researcher, and Rob Cochran, former head of product at CTRL-Labs, the neural interface company Meta absorbed in 2019.

key_facts.fact: Sprout is a 42-inch, 50-pound bipedal humanoid running on Nvidia's Jetson Orin platform, with a swappable 3-hour battery, priced at $50,000 for R&D partners. Early customers included Disney and Boston Dynamics.
key_facts.excerpt: Their product is Sprout: a 42-inch, 50-pound bipedal humanoid that runs on Nvidia's Jetson Orin platform, has a swappable battery lasting about three hours, and is priced at $50,000 for research and development partners. Early Sprout customers included Disney and Hyundai's Boston Dynamics.

key_facts.fact: Fauna raised at least $30 million from Kleiner Perkins, Quiet Capital and Lux Capital before the Amazon acquisition. The deal price was not disclosed.
key_facts.excerpt: The company raised at least $30 million from Kleiner Perkins, Quiet Capital, and Lux Capital before Amazon closed the deal for an undisclosed price.

key_facts.fact: Fauna joins Amazon's Personal Robotics Group, the same division that previously attempted and discontinued the Astro home robot in 2024 and abandoned the iRobot acquisition under regulatory pressure.
key_facts.excerpt: Fauna joins Amazon's Personal Robotics Group. This is the same division that attempted and failed with Astro, a home robot that Amazon ultimately bricked in 2024 after limited traction... Amazon also abandoned its iRobot acquisition that same year under regulatory pressure.

sources.title: Amazon buys Fauna Robotics, maker of the Sprout humanoid robot

stories.headline: Aditya Birla-Blackstone Consortium Buys Royal Challengers Bengaluru for $1.78 Billion

key_facts.fact: A consortium comprising Aditya Birla Group, The Times of India Group, Bolt Ventures and Blackstone agreed to acquire 100% of Royal Challengers Bengaluru from United Spirits (Diageo subsidiary) for INR 166.6 billion (~$1.78 billion).
key_facts.excerpt: A consortium comprising Aditya Birla Group, The Times of India Group, Bolt Ventures, and Blackstone has agreed to acquire 100% of Royal Challengers Bengaluru from United Spirits Limited in a transaction valuing the franchise at INR 166.6 billion, approximately $1.78 billion.

key_facts.fact: The deal includes both the men's IPL team and the women's WPL team. RCB won its first IPL title in 2025 and holds both IPL and Women's Premier League titles simultaneously.
key_facts.excerpt: The deal includes both the men's team competing in the Indian Premier League and the women's team in the Women's Premier League... Royal Challengers Bengaluru is one of the most prominent franchises in global cricket, having won its first IPL title in 2025.

key_facts.fact: Aryaman Vikram Birla will serve as Chairman and Satyan Gajwani as Vice Chairman of the franchise under the new ownership structure.
key_facts.excerpt: Under the new ownership structure, Aryaman Vikram Birla will serve as Chairman of the franchise, while Satyan Gajwani will serve as Vice Chairman.

key_facts.fact: The transaction marks a strategic exit for United Spirits (Diageo) to sharpen focus on its core beverage alcohol business. The acquisition is subject to BCCI and CCI approvals.
key_facts.excerpt: The transaction marks a strategic shift for United Spirits, a subsidiary of Diageo, as it sharpens its focus on its core beverage alcohol business... The acquisition remains subject to customary regulatory approvals, including from the Board of Control for Cricket in India and the Competition Commission of India.

stories.headline: Blackstone-Backed EPL to Merge with Indorama's Indovida in $2 Billion Packaging Deal

key_facts.fact: India's EPL Ltd agreed to merge with Indovida, backed by Thailand's Indorama Ventures, in a deal valuing the combined business at about $2 billion. EPL is valued at ~$1.2 billion and Indovida at ~$700 million.
key_facts.excerpt: Packaging company EPL Ltd said on Sunday it had agreed to merge with Indovida, backed by Thailand's Indorama Ventures, in a deal valuing the combined business at about $2 billion.

key_facts.fact: Post-merger, Indorama Ventures will become co-promoter with a 51.8% stake, while Blackstone (EPL's backer) will hold about 16.6% of the combined entity.
key_facts.excerpt: Following the merger, Indorama Ventures will become a co-promoter with a 51.8% stake in the combined company, while private equity firm Blackstone, which backs EPL, will hold about 16.6%.

key_facts.fact: The merged group will combine EPL's packaging operations with Indovida's plastics portfolio. EPL is implied at 339 Indian rupees per share. The deal is expected to close within about a year.
key_facts.excerpt: The merged group will combine EPL's packaging operations with Indovida's plastics portfolio... EPL is valued at about $1.2 billion, implying a price of 339 Indian rupees per share.

stories.headline: Garanti BBVA Sells Romania Banking Unit to Raiffeisen Bank for €591 Million

key_facts.fact: Turkey-based Garanti (85% owned by Spain's BBVA) signed a €591 million ($682 million) deal to sell its Romania operations to Austria's Raiffeisen Bank International.
key_facts.excerpt: Türkiye-based lender Garanti, in which Spain's BBVA holds an 85% stake, has signed a €591 million ($682.22 million) deal to sell its Romania operations to Austria's Raiffeisen Bank.

key_facts.fact: The deal transfers full shares in Garanti Bank S.A. and Motoractive IFN S.A. and is expected to close in Q4 2026, subject to regulatory approvals.
key_facts.excerpt: The transaction includes the full transfer of shares in Garanti Bank S.A. and Motoractive IFN S.A... The deal is subject to approvals from relevant regulatory authorities and is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026.

key_facts.fact: Garanti's Romanian unit has 67 branches, 1,118 employees and total assets of approximately $5.17 billion. It has operated in Romania since 1998.
key_facts.excerpt: As of the last quarter of 2025, Garanti's Romania operations included 67 branches and 1,118 employees. The unit reported total assets of ₺204.36 billion ($5.17 billion).

key_facts.fact: The acquisition will make Raiffeisen the third-largest bank in Romania by total assets. RBI's Romanian subsidiaries currently hold €17.5 billion ($20.2 billion) in assets.
key_facts.excerpt: RBI's Romanian subsidiaries hold €17.5 billion ($20.2 billion) in assets, and the acquisition is expected to make Raiffeisen Bank S.A. the third-largest bank in Romania by total assets.

key_facts.fact: Vedanta chairman Anil Agarwal confirmed that the company, with an enterprise value of $37 billion, will split into five separately listed entities starting in April 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Vedanta, which is one of India's largest resources companies with an enterprise value of $37 billion, has been planning to restructure for several years.

key_facts.fact: The demerger, reported by the Financial Times, will create five standalone listed companies from one of India's largest natural resources conglomerates.
key_facts.excerpt: India's Vedanta to split into five companies next month, FT reports.

key_facts.fact: The restructuring has been planned for several years but faced multiple hurdles. Agarwal's confirmation of the April timeline represents a firm commitment to proceed.
key_facts.excerpt: Vedanta, which is one of India's largest resources companies with an enterprise value of $37 billion, has been planning to restructure for several years. However, it has faced hurdles.

key_facts.fact: Boardwalk Pipelines entered an agreement to acquire Spire Marketing Inc., a gas marketing business unit, from Spire Inc. (NYSE: SR) for $215 million.
key_facts.excerpt: Boardwalk Pipelines, LP, today announced it has entered into an agreement to acquire Spire Marketing Inc., a gas marketing business unit, from Spire Inc.

key_facts.fact: The acquisition expands Boardwalk's presence across the natural gas value chain, adding Spire Marketing's established commercial and trading capabilities.
key_facts.excerpt: This acquisition would expand Boardwalk's presence across the natural gas value chain, enhancing its long-term growth and operating strategy.

key_facts.fact: Spire is divesting the unit to sharpen focus on core regulated utility operations, simplify its business mix, and improve its risk profile. The deal is expected to close in Q2 2026.

key_facts.excerpt: Barclays served as financial advisor, and GableGotwals served as legal counsel to Boardwalk in connection with the transaction.

stories.headline: Austria Delays FDI Clearance for JD.com's $2.5 Billion Takeover of Ceconomy

key_facts.fact: Austrian regulators have not approved Chinese e-commerce giant JD.com's proposed acquisition of German electronics retailer Ceconomy (owner of MediaMarkt and Saturn), putting the deal at risk.
key_facts.excerpt: Austrian regulators have yet to approve Chinese e-commerce group JD.com's proposed acquisition of German electronics retailer Ceconomy, leaving a key approval outstanding and putting the wider transaction at risk.

key_facts.fact: Ceconomy said the Austrian Federal Ministry of Economy has raised concerns and refused to engage in a joint solution-finding process, despite FDI clearances already obtained in France and Italy.
key_facts.excerpt: The company confirmed that all necessary merger control approvals have been obtained, alongside FDI clearances in France and Italy... the Austrian Federal Ministry of Economy has expressed concerns regarding the approvability of the transaction and refused to engage in a joint solution-finding process.

key_facts.fact: Austria's economy ministry denied on March 30 that it was being obstructive, insisting it was cooperating on the deal review.
key_facts.excerpt: Austria's economy ministry on Monday denied it was being obstructive in approving a deal between German electronics retailer Ceconomy and Chinese e-commerce company JD.com, insisting it was being cooperative.

key_facts.fact: The investment agreement between Ceconomy and JD.com was signed on July 30, 2025. JD.com had committed to safeguards on locations, employment, data protection and management independence.
key_facts.excerpt: The investment agreement between Ceconomy and JD.com was signed on 30 July 2025... JD.com had previously committed to safeguards relating to locations, employment, data protection and management independence.

stories.headline: Federal Judge Halts $6.2B Nexstar-Tegna Integration After Antitrust Challenge

key_facts.fact: US District Judge Troy L. Nunley in Sacramento granted DirecTV's request to pause Nexstar-Tegna post-merger integration, even though the deal had already closed days earlier.
key_facts.excerpt: US District Judge Troy L. Nunley in Sacramento granted DirecTV's request to pause the companies' post-merger integration efforts, even though the deal had already been finalized days earlier.

key_facts.fact: The combined entity would control 265 full-power television stations reaching approximately 80% of US households, though Nexstar has agreed to divest six stations at FCC request.
key_facts.excerpt: the combined entity would control 265 full-power television stations, reaching approximately 80% of US households, though Nexstar has agreed to divest six stations at the request of the Federal Communications Commission.

key_facts.fact: Judge Nunley noted the companies 'do not contest this merger will increase Nexstar's bargaining leverage to extract higher fees' for retransmission rates charged to cable and satellite providers.
key_facts.excerpt: the companies 'do not contest this merger will increase Nexstar's bargaining leverage to extract higher fees.' These fees, known as retransmission rates, are charged by broadcasters to cable and satellite providers and can ultimately be passed on to consumers.

key_facts.fact: The court ordered the companies to maintain and operate Tegna's business as independent, economically viable, and active competitors while the legal challenge proceeds.
key_facts.excerpt: The companies must now maintain and operate Tegna's business as independent, ongoing, economically viable, and active competitors.

key_facts.fact: A coalition of states led by California and New York also sued, pointing to 13 overlapping markets where the combined entity would control over 30% of retransmission revenue.
key_facts.excerpt: A coalition of states led by California and New York has also sued. Their motion points to 13 overlapping markets where the combined entity would control over 30% of retransmission revenue.

key_facts.fact: A hearing is scheduled for April 7 to determine whether the pause should remain in place pending a full trial.
key_facts.excerpt: Nunley has scheduled a hearing for April 7 to determine whether the pause should remain in place pending a full trial.

stories.headline: DOJ Issues Subpoenas in $110B Paramount-Warner Bros. Discovery Merger Probe

key_facts.fact: The US Department of Justice has begun issuing subpoenas as part of its investigation into the proposed $110 billion acquisition involving Paramount Skydance and Warner Bros. Discovery.
key_facts.excerpt: The U.S. Department of Justice has begun issuing subpoenas as part of its ongoing investigation into the proposed $110 billion acquisition involving Paramount Skydance and Warner Bros. Discovery.

key_facts.fact: DOJ investigators are examining how the combined company would influence studio output, content rights ownership, and streaming competition, plus downstream effects on movie theaters.
key_facts.excerpt: regulators are now focusing on how the merger could reshape competition, content distribution, and the broader media landscape... investigators are also examining potential downstream effects on movie theaters

key_facts.fact: Acting Assistant Attorney General Omeed Assefi said Paramount will 'absolutely not' be fast-tracked for approval due to political considerations.
key_facts.excerpt: Acting Assistant Attorney General Omeed Assefi recently emphasized that the deal would not receive expedited treatment, stating that Paramount will 'absolutely not' be fast-tracked for approval due to political considerations.

key_facts.fact: The European Commission has reportedly begun engaging with third parties, while Canadian authorities and the California Attorney General's office are also consulting industry participants.
key_facts.excerpt: The European Commission has reportedly begun engaging with third parties, while Canadian authorities have reached out to at least one company for input. In the United States, the California Attorney General's office is similarly consulting industry participants.

key_facts.fact: Paramount has committed to paying Warner Bros. shareholders a quarterly 'ticking fee' of 25 cents per share starting in October if the deal remains incomplete.
key_facts.excerpt: the company has committed to paying Warner Bros. shareholders a quarterly 'ticking fee' of 25 cents per share starting in October if the deal remains incomplete.

key_facts.fact: Paramount projected approximately $6 billion in cost synergies from the merger; the Teamsters union warned the deal 'poses a direct threat' to employment.
key_facts.excerpt: Paramount has projected approximately $6 billion in cost synergies from the merger... The Teamsters union warned that the merger 'poses a direct threat' to employment and urged regulators to block the deal.

stories.headline: RTL Offers EU Remedies to Fast-Track Sky Deutschland Takeover Approval

key_facts.excerpt: RTL is preparing to offer remedies to EU regulators in a move likely to secure early approval for its planned acquisition of Sky Deutschland... Possible remedies could include outsourcing advertising sales to third parties.

key_facts.fact: If remedies are submitted, the Commission's preliminary review deadline would be extended by 10 working days beyond the current April 8, 2026 deadline, with approval likely at the end of the initial review.
key_facts.excerpt: If RTL submits remedies, the Commission's preliminary review deadline would be extended by 10 working days beyond the current 8 April 2026 deadline, with approval likely at the end of the initial review.

key_facts.fact: The acquisition would combine major sports rights including Bundesliga, Premier League, and Formula 1, and strengthen RTL's streaming position through Sky's WOW service.
key_facts.excerpt: The acquisition would combine major sports and entertainment rights, including Bundesliga, Premier League and Formula 1, and strengthen RTL's position in streaming through Sky's WOW service.

key_facts.fact: German media regulator KEK cleared the transaction in September 2025, concluding combined audience share remained below thresholds indicating dominant opinion power.
key_facts.excerpt: In September 2025, German media regulator KEK cleared the transaction, concluding that the combined audience share of RTL Deutschland, Sky Deutschland and NBC Universal Global Networks Deutschland would remain below thresholds indicating dominant opinion power.

key_facts.fact: RTL Group reported 2025 revenue of €6.0 billion, with streaming revenue rising 26% to €509 million and 8.1 million paying subscribers (+19%).
key_facts.excerpt: RTL Group reported revenue of €6.0 billion for 2025, with streaming revenue rising 26% to €509 million and paying subscribers increasing 19% to 8.1 million.

stories.headline: Sysco Strikes $29.1B Deal for Jetro Restaurant Depot, Faces Antitrust Scrutiny

key_facts.fact: Sysco announced a $29.1 billion deal to acquire Jetro Restaurant Depot in cash and stock, with Restaurant Depot shareholders receiving $21.6 billion in cash and 91.5 million Sysco shares.
key_facts.excerpt: The giant broadline distributor... said that it has a deal to acquire Jetro Restaurant Depot for $29.1 billion in cash and stock. Restaurant Depot shareholders will receive $21.6 billion in cash in the deal and 91.5 million shares of Sysco stock.

key_facts.fact: The deal values Restaurant Depot at 14.6x operating income; the company operates 166 warehouse stores in 35 states generating $16 billion in annual revenue and $2.1 billion in EBITDA.
key_facts.excerpt: The total value of the deal represents a multiple of 14.6 times Restaurant Depot's operating income... It operates 166 large-format warehouse stores in 35 states that generate $16 billion in annual revenue, including $2.1 billion in EBITDA.

key_facts.fact: The combined company would generate nearly $100 billion in annual revenue and $6.4 billion in adjusted EBITDA, with $250 million in annual cost synergies projected within three years.

key_facts.fact: Sysco plans to fund the cash component with $21 billion in new debt and $1 billion in cash on hand; Restaurant Depot shareholders will own about 16% of Sysco stock post-close.
key_facts.excerpt: Sysco plans to fund the cash in the deal with $21 billion in new debt and $1 billion in cash on hand. Once the deal is complete, Restaurant Depot shareholders will own about 16% of Sysco stock.

key_facts.fact: Restaurant Depot serves approximately 725,000 independent restaurant operators annually; Sysco plans to leverage its scale to open more than 125 new Restaurant Depot locations.
key_facts.excerpt: Restaurant Depot serves about 725,000 such operators every year... Sysco will be able to leverage its size and scale to open more than 125 new Restaurant Depot locations across the country.

stories.headline: UK CMA Unveils 2026/27 Plan With Major Merger Control Reset

key_facts.fact: The CMA will 'step back' in global mergers to avoid unnecessary duplication with international counterparts and will be open to accepting behavioral remedies, a significant shift from prior reluctance.
key_facts.excerpt: In global mergers, the CMA will seek to 'step back' and avoid unnecessary duplication with international counterparts. The CMA will be open to exploring wider remedy packages, including behavioural remedies, which it had previously been very reluctant to accept.

key_facts.fact: Structural reform of the merger control process is planned, including replacing the independent Phase 2 panel with sub-committees of the CMA board comprising executives, non-executives, and industry experts.
key_facts.excerpt: Change of how Phase II merger decisions are taken by replacing the Phase II independent panel... with sub-committees of the CMA board, comprising CMA executives, non-executive directors and non-CMA staff industry experts.

key_facts.fact: The CMA plans to clarify share of supply (25%) and hybrid (33%) tests to limit its discretion with a closed set of specified statutory criteria for asserting jurisdiction.
key_facts.excerpt: Clarifying certain statutory tests... in particular the 'share of supply' and 'hybrid' tests... The aim is to limit the CMA's discretion with a closed set of specified statutory criteria.

key_facts.fact: The CMA is escalating enforcement against bid-rigging in public procurement, leveraging AI and data science to scan bidding data, with cartelists now facing debarment under the Procurement Act 2023.
key_facts.excerpt: The CMA is escalating its enforcement efforts against bid-rigging in public procurement, leveraging AI and data science tools to scan bidding data... the deterrent effect of enforcement action is expected to increase significantly now that cartelists face debarment under the Procurement Act 2023.

key_facts.fact: The CMA has completed its first Strategic Market Status designations for search and mobile platforms under the Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act.
key_facts.excerpt: The CMA has completed its first Strategic Market Status ('SMS') designations in respect of search and mobile platforms. It is now moving to design and implement interventions with a phased approach.

sources.title: CMA Charts a New Course for 2026/27

stories.headline: Naver-Dunamu Merger Delayed Three Months Amid Korean Antitrust Review

key_facts.fact: Naver disclosed on March 30 that the shareholder meeting for the share exchange between subsidiary Naver Financial and Dunamu (operator of Upbit, Korea's largest crypto exchange) has been postponed from May 22 to August 18, with deal closing pushed from June 30 to September 30.
key_facts.excerpt: Naver (035420.KS) disclosed on the 30th that the shareholder meeting for the comprehensive share exchange between its subsidiary Naver Financial and Dunamu... has been postponed from May 22 to August 18. The deal closing date has also been pushed back from June 30 to September 30.

key_facts.fact: Korea's Fair Trade Commission accepted the merger filing in November 2025 and is closely examining market dominance and monopoly concerns as the deal combines leaders in mobile payments and cryptocurrency markets.
key_facts.excerpt: The Fair Trade Commission (FTC) accepted the merger filing from both companies in November last year and launched its review. As the deal combines the leading players in mobile payments and cryptocurrency markets, the FTC is known to be closely examining market dominance and potential monopoly concerns.

key_facts.fact: The FTC review deadline was extended after the commission recently requested additional materials from both companies.
key_facts.excerpt: The original review deadline was the 28th of this month, but the period was extended after the FTC recently requested additional materials.

key_facts.fact: The Digital Asset Basic Act, being pushed by the government and ruling party, would limit major shareholder stakes in crypto exchanges to 20%, or up to 34% with Financial Services Commission approval.
key_facts.excerpt: The government and the ruling party are currently pushing to limit stakes held by exchange major shareholders and their related parties to 20% or below through the Digital Asset Basic Act. A framework has been set to allow up to 34% for entities approved by the Financial Services Commission.

key_facts.fact: Naver stated the content of the Digital Asset Basic Act 'once enacted and enforced could potentially affect the progress or outcome of this comprehensive share exchange.'
key_facts.excerpt: discussions on the Digital Asset Basic Act appear to be underway, and the content of such legislation, once enacted and implemented, may affect the progress or outcome of the comprehensive stock swap.

sources.title: Naver-Dunamu Merger Delayed Three Months Amid Antitrust Review

stories.headline: FCC Warns NFL's Streaming Shift May Threaten Its Antitrust Exemption

key_facts.fact: FCC Chairman Brendan Carr warned the NFL's increasing shift toward paid streaming platforms may challenge the league's antitrust exemption under the Sports Broadcasting Act of 1961.
key_facts.excerpt: FCC Chairman Brendan Carr said the NFL's current strategy—placing more games behind paid streaming services—may challenge the legal protections the league has long relied on.

key_facts.fact: The Sports Broadcasting Act of 1961 allows the NFL to negotiate TV rights collectively, but was crafted for free over-the-air broadcasts — creating a legal gray area for cable, satellite, and streaming.
key_facts.excerpt: That exemption stems from the Sports Broadcasting Act of 1961, which allows the NFL to negotiate television rights collectively rather than on a team-by-team basis. However, the law was crafted in an era dominated by free, over-the-air broadcasts.

key_facts.fact: Carr warned there may be a 'tipping point' where placing too many games behind paywalls could undermine the exemption entirely.
key_facts.excerpt: Carr warned there may be a 'tipping point' where placing too many games behind paywalls could undermine the exemption entirely.

key_facts.fact: The NFL is negotiating future media rights deals, including CBS contracts that could extend beyond 2029 at higher fees than the current $2.1 billion annual agreement.

stories.headline: Sysco to Acquire Jetro Restaurant Depot for $29.1B in Cash and Stock

key_facts.fact: Sysco will pay $21.6 billion in cash and 91.5 million Sysco shares for Jetro Restaurant Depot, totaling $29.1 billion including debt.
key_facts.excerpt: Sysco said that it has a deal to acquire Jetro Restaurant Depot for $29.1 billion in cash and stock. Restaurant Depot shareholders will receive $21.6 billion in cash in the deal and 91.5 million shares of Sysco stock.

key_facts.fact: Restaurant Depot operates 166 warehouse stores in 35 states generating $16 billion in annual revenue and $2.1 billion in EBITDA, implying a 14.6x operating income multiple.
key_facts.excerpt: It operates 166 large-format warehouse stores in 35 states that generate $16 billion in annual revenue, including $2.1 billion in EBITDA. The total value of the deal represents a multiple of 14.6 times Restaurant Depot's operating income.

key_facts.fact: Sysco plans to fund the deal with $21 billion in new and hybrid debt plus $1 billion in cash on hand; Restaurant Depot shareholders will own 16% of Sysco upon closing.
key_facts.excerpt: Sysco would fund the deal through $21 billion of new and hybrid debt, along with $1 billion of cash and equity on hand.

key_facts.fact: The combined company generated nearly $100 billion in revenue and $6.4 billion in adjusted EBITDA, with $250 million in projected annual cost synergies within three years.
key_facts.excerpt: The combined company last year generated nearly $100 billion in revenue and $6.4 billion in adjusted EBITDA. The combined companies are projecting $250 million in annual cost synergies within the first three years.

key_facts.fact: Sysco expects the deal to be accretive to EPS in the mid- to high-single digits in the first year, with closing expected by Q3 FY2027.
key_facts.excerpt: Sysco expects the deal to add to earnings per share in the mid- to high-single-digits in the first year following its close, which is expected by the third quarter of Sysco's fiscal 2027.

key_facts.fact: Sysco shares fell nearly 5% in premarket trading after the announcement; the company also paused its share repurchase program.
key_facts.excerpt: Shares of Sysco, which has a market capitalization of $39.2 billion, were down nearly 5% in premarket trading. Sysco also said it was pausing its share repurchase program.

stories.headline: Eli Lilly Signs $2.75B Licensing Deal with AI Drug Developer Insilico Medicine

key_facts.excerpt: Insilico Medicine said on Sunday it has agreed a global licensing and research deal with U.S. drugmaker Eli Lilly, that could be worth up to $2.75 billion, including milestone payments.

key_facts.fact: Lilly receives exclusive license to develop, manufacture, and commercialize Insilico's preclinical oral drug candidates, including a GLP-1 candidate for diabetes.
key_facts.excerpt: Under the agreement, Lilly will receive an exclusive licence to develop, manufacture and commercialize preclinical oral drug candidates by Insilico Medicine for selected disease areas.

key_facts.fact: Insilico is eligible for development, regulatory, and commercial milestone payments plus tiered royalties on future sales.
key_facts.excerpt: Insilico Medicine also said that it will receive an upfront payment of $115 million and is eligible for development, regulatory and commercial milestone payments that could take the total deal value to about $2.75 billion, as well as tiered royalties on future sales.

key_facts.fact: The deal reflects pharma's increasing turn to AI to accelerate R&D, aligned with the FDA's push to reduce animal testing.
key_facts.excerpt: Pharmaceutical companies are increasingly turning to AI to accelerate R&D, betting on new modelling tools and automated labs to unlock efficiency gains across their pipeline.

key_facts.fact: Insilico Medicine is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange; its CEO Alex Zhavoronkov described Lilly as 'better in AI than Insilico.'
key_facts.excerpt: Alex Zhavoronkov, CEO of Insilico Medicine, can't stop complimenting Eli Lilly. 'Lilly is better in AI than Insilico, and no other company is better in AI than us … except for these guys,' he said.

stories.headline: DOJ Issues Subpoenas in Paramount-Warner Bros. Discovery $110B Merger Probe

key_facts.excerpt: The U.S. Department of Justice has begun issuing subpoenas as part of its ongoing investigation into the proposed $110 billion acquisition involving Paramount Skydance and Warner Bros. Discovery.

key_facts.fact: Investigators are examining how the combined company would influence studio output, content rights ownership, streaming competition, and downstream effects on movie theaters.
key_facts.excerpt: Regulators are now focusing on how the merger could reshape competition, content distribution, and the broader media landscape... investigators are also examining potential downstream effects on movie theaters.

key_facts.excerpt: Acting Assistant Attorney General Omeed Assefi recently emphasized that the deal would not receive expedited treatment, stating that Paramount will 'absolutely not' be fast-tracked for approval due to political considerations.

key_facts.fact: Paramount has committed to paying WBD shareholders a quarterly 'ticking fee' of 25 cents per share starting October if the deal remains incomplete.

key_facts.fact: Paramount projects approximately $6 billion in cost synergies from the merger, mostly from streamlining technology, real estate, and corporate functions.
key_facts.excerpt: Paramount has projected approximately $6 billion in cost synergies from the merger... the company expects most of these savings to come from streamlining technology infrastructure, real estate, and other corporate functions.

stories.headline: Federal Judge Halts Nexstar-Tegna $6.2B Merger Integration on Antitrust Grounds

key_facts.excerpt: US District Judge Troy L. Nunley in Sacramento granted DirecTV's request to pause the companies' post-merger integration efforts, even though the deal had already been finalized days earlier.

stories.headline: Elliott Wins Board Overhaul at Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings
